fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown in the portal sidebar and page headings. Defaults to the Document Type's plural name if left blank.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Lucide icon name (without the icon- prefix), e.g. "shopping-cart"

fields.label: Supplier Fieldname
fields.description: Field on Document Type that links to Supplier -- used to filter records to the logged-in vendor's own

fields.label: Docstatus Filter
fields.description: For a submittable Document Type only. "Submitted Only" (e.g. Purchase Order) hides drafts and cancelled records everywhere in the portal -- list, dashboard count, and direct-URL detail access. "All" (e.g. Purchase Invoice) shows every stage.

fields.label: Restrict To Role
fields.description: Optional -- if set, only vendor users with this role see this item in the sidebar and can access it. Leave blank for visible-to-every-vendor (the default).

fields.label: Title Field
fields.description: Field shown as the row/detail title. Defaults to the document name if left blank.

fields.label: Line Items Table Fieldname
fields.description: Optional -- child table fieldname to render as a line-items table on the detail page, e.g. "items"

fields.label: Edit Via Web Form
fields.description: Optional -- if set, the detail page shows an Edit button linking to this Web Form (?name=<docname>), so the vendor can edit the record instead of only viewing it. Access is still governed by the Web Form's own permission check (Portal User linkage for Supplier-linked doctypes).

fields.label: Show In Sidebar Nav
fields.description: Turn off for a row that exists only to configure an Edit Via Web Form lookup (e.g. Supplier, looked up by My Profile) without giving it its own sidebar link.

fields.label: Tab Group
fields.description: Optional -- rows sharing the same Tab Group key merge into ONE sidebar item, shown as tabs on the same list page instead of separate sidebar entries. Leave blank for a normal standalone row.

fields.label: Group Sidebar Label
fields.description: Sidebar text for the whole group, e.g. "Orders & Invoices" -- set this on whichever row should be the default tab (its own Route is what the sidebar link opens first); other rows in the group can leave it blank.

fields.label: Group Sidebar Icon
fields.description: Optional -- icon for the group's sidebar item. Defaults to this row's own Icon if left blank.

fields.label: Allow Attaching Invoice Copy
fields.description: Shows an "Attach Invoice Copy" upload on the detail page for records not yet fully billed (see Billed Percent Fieldname) -- e.g. Purchase Order, so a vendor can upload their invoice against an order still awaiting one.

fields.label: Billed Percent Fieldname
fields.description: Field on Document Type holding the 0-100 billed percentage -- the upload only shows while this is under 100. Leave as-is for Purchase Order's standard "per_billed".

fields.label: Linked Document Type
fields.description: Optional -- shows a "Linked <these>" list on the detail page (e.g. Purchase Invoice on a Purchase Order). Must also be a Document Type configured as its own row here, so its route/labels/status field are reused for display.

fields.label: Linked Via Child Table
fields.description: The Linked Document Type's own child table doctype that holds the back-link -- e.g. "Purchase Invoice Item" (the link lives on the invoice's line items, not the invoice itself).

fields.label: Linked Via Fieldname
fields.description: Field on that child table linking back to this row's own Document Type, e.g. "purchase_order".

fields.label: Linked Documents Section Label
fields.description: Optional -- defaults to the Linked Document Type's own Label if left blank.
